title: High Performance Computing of SDRE models with Discrete Kalman Filtering for Robust $H_{\infty}$-Controls
summary: State-dependent Riccati equation (SDRE) control requires repeated online solution of continuous-time algebraic Riccati equations (CAREs). A projected-channel $H_\infty$ formulation preserves the physical actuator and sensor dimensions of under-actuated, partially observed systems. We derive a computable sufficient attenuation bound for positive-semidefinite stabilizing Riccati solutions and construct an update that enforces their spectral-radius coupling condition.
